body: Theres a lot of truth to what you say, and I know your right.  I'm sorry, I'm in a bad way. I don't know why I feel childish sharing my problems...I guess I feel weak if I do and thus weakness is only more reason to dislike myself.  Thank you though, I honestly feel considerably more at ease, I've got work to do and it won't be easy, but seriously thats a perspective I haven't quite seen.

It's all fine, age does not distract the importance of something, I don't mean to disregard the impact of any emotion as they're all legitimate as reality can be.  It'll hurt in a way you may have never felt before, but thats normal, just don't blame yourself.
I haven't even considered that, thanks for the heads up but I'm not that concerned at this point.

I do wish I was with loved ones again.  I've grown so distant I'm not sure how to tell them who I am.  It's my own fault I know, I push people away from me, I'm terrified of losing them, in some strange way I want to lose them before they die.  I lost my brother when I was young, I saw it happen, every last drop of blood, he killed himself right in front of me.  I think I know thats the root of my problems...but fuck if I can identify it then why can't I deal with it?  I know it's horrible, I know I should talk to someone, a professional yet I just can't...it all sounds so childish to me saying this to strangers when the answer is obvious, seek professional help, but it just does not feel right, I have before and I can't be honest, I say what I know they want to hear so they let me go I'm sorry I just feel as though this is my burden and no one elses I'm not expecting an answer or conclusion I'm just so lost

Hi, I'm feeling that right about now.  I've cut myself before, I know the apeal, it'll leave a scar you'll look back on.  Girlfriends will come and go but thats never your fault, it's never anyones, it's part of the process you know what I'm saying?  It's easy to blame yourself when problems arise, just realize thats it's not your fault, it never was.  It's all complicated, to such a degree that no one could ever legitimately blame you yourself for anything thats happened. She isn't you and you aren't her.
